children: U.S. spot ETH ETFs recorded net outflows for 23 consecutive trading days, their longest such streak since launch. According to ChainCatcher, Glassnode said the trend points to weak demand from traditional investors, who had made substantial purchases in August and September. Glassnode published the remarks on October 31.

title: Glassnode: U.S. Spot ETH ETFs Post 23 Straight Days of Net Outflows
